resources.string: Lets Fan detect a tap on the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar, and open the app switcher sheet.
Fan is not an app you open. After setup, tap the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar to switch apps. It needs a couple of permissions first.
All set. Tap the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar from any app.
Lets Fan notice a tap on the corner of the navigation bar. Find Fan in the list and switch it on.
If the switch is greyed out: open the app info page, tap the ⋮ menu and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Lets Fan see which apps you have used recently, to build the list of open apps.
Nothing recorded yet. Enable the accessibility service, then touch the bottom-right corner.

With gesture navigation, the system takes over a swipe that starts in a strip along the bottom of the screen, and Recents opens. Raise the touch target until a swipe up from it stays with Fan. Touching it opens the sheet, and a long press opens these settings.
Distance from the right edge: %1$d dp

Row 1 is closest to the corner. Icons fill row 1 first, then the next row out. Each row sizes its icons to its width. The sheet lists as many apps as all the rows hold. A row\'s width is how far it reaches along the bottom edge; the widths add up to the sheet\'s size.
Gap from the corner to row 1: %1$d dp
Padding from the bottom edge to the first icon: %1$d dp
Padding from the side edge to the last icon: %1$d dp
These apps never show on the sheet, and a double tap never switches to them.
